document.subject: Dark Queen / Sofía Arauz
document.purpose: Define a reusable personal brand for portfolio websites, blogs, professional materials and social channels.

name_usage.creative_identity: Use Dark Queen as the creative brand name.
name_usage.professional_identity: Keep Sofía Arauz clearly visible in introductions, contact information and professional materials.
name_usage.social_identity: Use darkqueen.exe as the social handle and digital signature.

brand_identity.core_message: A dark, expressive personal brand combining game testing, 3D world-building, alternative fashion and gothic visual culture.
audience: Readers interested in game testing, environment art and game development

brand_pillars.testing: Careful observation, clear reporting and attention to player experience.
brand_pillars.world_building: Intentional environments, atmosphere and visual storytelling.
brand_pillars.personal_expression: An alternative creative identity grounded in personal style.
brand_pillars.detail: Deliberate choices in both technical work and visual craft.

messaging.primary_statement: I test worlds and build them too.
messaging.positioning_copy: Game QA and 3D Environment Art with a focus on detail, atmosphere and player experience.
supporting_copy_examples: Creating better worlds, one detail at a time.
writing_rules: Use sentence case for interface copy.
Use clear action labels such as View work and About me.
Support expressive headlines with concrete descriptions of the work.
Choose one main statement per application rather than using every supporting line together.

material_and_texture_cues: Dark photography with selective red emphasis
visual_direction.design_principle: Pair expressive gothic identity elements with clean, readable professional content. Texture and ornament support the identity while text and work samples remain legible.

color_palette.name: Blood Red
color_palette.role: Passion, creativity, emphasis and signature accents

color_palette.name: Charcoal
color_palette.role: Secondary dark neutral and visual balance

color_palette.name: Stone
color_palette.role: Primary light contrast and logo/text color

rules: Let dark neutrals dominate, with stone text and restrained red accents.
Use dusty rose for softer personal accents and moss for environmental references.
Avoid equal visual emphasis across all six colors.
Choose readable text/background combinations; treat red and muted accents primarily as graphic colors.

typography.role: Primary wordmark and selected display headlines
typography.usage: Use for short identity statements rather than body copy or dense technical information.

typography.role: Body text, navigation, UI and technical content
typography.usage: Use for project descriptions, blog articles, skills, contact information and QA documentation.

typography.status: Provisional font choice; exact family and style require confirmation.
typography.usage: Do not treat the font name as a verified handwritten typeface. Handwritten signatures and notes are separate graphic treatments.

primary_logotype.description: A stone/off-white gothic Dark Queen wordmark paired with a red handwritten Sofía Arauz signature.
primary_logotype.role: Introduce the complete creative and personal identity.

symbol.description: A narrow four-pointed star or cross-like symbol with hand-drawn horizontal scratch lines.

secondary_mark.description: An angular, symmetrical star/compass-like geometric emblem with thin distressed lines.

monogram.description: Interlocking gothic D and Q letterforms with a small four-pointed star beneath.

usage_rules: Use the primary logotype when the audience needs to learn the brand name.
Use one main identity mark per placement.
Preserve proportions and leave clear space around each mark.
Use simplified or compact marks where the full logotype would be too small to read.
Keep red signatures and distressed details subordinate to the wordmark.

graphic_language.treatment: Combine thin distressed linework, selective red marks and dark textured fields with a clear typographic hierarchy.
graphic_language.restraint: Use a small selection of motifs in each application. Keep detailed ornament away from body text and interface controls.
graphic_language.relationship_to_content: Motifs express the creative identity; written labels communicate navigation, skills and project categories.

imagery.photographic_direction: Dark, expressive photography with strong contrast, retained shadow detail and selective red emphasis.
selection_rules: Use portraits to introduce the person behind the brand.
Use environment art and game captures as evidence of the work.
Use lifestyle references selectively to give context to the creative identity.
Preserve important visual details in artwork and screenshots rather than applying a uniform dark filter.

layout_and_hierarchy.alignment: Mostly left-aligned content within a disciplined grid.
layout_and_hierarchy.hierarchy: Give the brand name or a concise identity statement a clear focal role. Follow with professional positioning, work and contact information.
layout_and_hierarchy.contrast: Balance oversized expressive type or imagery with quiet, readable information blocks.
layout_and_hierarchy.spacing: Use generous space around identity elements and consistent spacing in navigation, articles and technical content.
layout_and_hierarchy.adaptation: Adjust the grid and image crops to the format. Stack content in a clear reading order on narrow screens.
layout_and_hierarchy.principle: The identity defines a visual system, not a fixed arrangement of panels or a required image collage.

portfolio_website.purpose: Introduce Sofía and show evidence of Game QA and 3D Environment Art work.
portfolio_website.hero_headline: I test worlds and build them too.
portfolio_website.hero_copy: Game QA and 3D Environment Art with a focus on detail, atmosphere and player experience.
portfolio_website.visual_guidance: Use a dark identity-led opening with a portrait or game environment. Keep project descriptions, skills and contact paths easy to read.

blog.purpose: Share game-testing observations, environment-art processes and development notes.
blog.visual_guidance: Use Inter for long-form reading, short expressive headlines, dark neutral fields and restrained branded cover graphics.

business_card.purpose: Connect the creative identity to a clear professional name and contact details.
business_card.visual_guidance: Use a dark background, stone text and a restrained red signature or compact symbol.

social_profiles.visual_guidance: Use a compact identity mark or portrait for the avatar and consistent palette and motifs across covers.

merchandise.visual_guidance: Use a small stone-colored compact mark, with a restrained red accent where the production method supports it.

specification_notes: This specification defines the Dark Queen visual identity. It is separate from the Ritual / System identity and its broken-halo asset kit.
Hex values are the defined palette tokens for this identity, not measured values from photography.
Logo descriptions define the intended forms; final vector artwork determines exact geometry and production dimensions.
Reckless Neue remains a provisional accent-font reference rather than a confirmed handwritten font.
